note: Which vector model is drawn for each type of the park map. model: a name known to Models::byName, drawn by models/<model>.cpp. semi_model: the model for half of a semi-detached block (a house with semi_with in data/houses.json). size: 'model' -> the model decides its size from the outline of the house (Model::footprint); 'outline' -> the outline is used as it is. To show a type with another model, change it here.

4C.why: Every 4C is half of a semi-detached block, drawn by Comfort4C (photos Type_4C_b, _c, _d, _half and brick-fence); a detached one would be a comfort bungalow, photographed as 6C (house 17).

4CT.why: Comfort bungalow, photographed as 6C (house 17); half of a semi-detached block as 4C (houses 14 and 15).

6C.why: Comfort bungalow, photographed as 6C (house 17); half of a semi-detached block as 4C (houses 14 and 15).

8C.why: Photographed from all sides (houses 3, 56 and others); the plan is that of the BGT, the same for every 8C.

6CK.why: Not photographed; houses 26 and 29 look like house 3, and the BGT has the outline of the 8C for all five.

12L.why: Photographed (house 411, photos 12La-d); every 12L has the same plan in the BGT, which the model draws.

24L.why: Not photographed; the largest villas take the 8L.

10L.why: Photographed (houses 405, 420 and others, from all sides but the back); from outside the same house as the 10LT.

10LT.why: Photographed (house 405); from outside the same house as the 10L, so drawn by the same model.

6EL.why: Photographed (B427): the 8L with a bay window across the front gable and a brick chimney in its middle.

8EL.why: Photographed (B427, house 427 is an 8EL): the 6EL on a longer outline.

Krimweg73.why: The one house of its type, Krimweg 73: drawn from its photographs (Krimweg_73_RD_118546574790, _b, _c, _d), the plan from its BGT outline, the heights from the AHN.

A4.why: Old park, 1957 to 1996: 4 persons, type A on the park map; the red door, the smallest. Photographed.

A6.why: Old park: 6 persons, type A on the park map; the green door. Photographed.

B4.why: Old park: 4 persons, type B on the park map; the yellow door, the largest. Photographed.

B6.why: Old park: 6 persons, type B on the park map, the chalets north-east of the park from 1971: no model yet, drawn as a safari tent for now (Jan de Kort, 2026-11-21).

Taveerne.why: Old park: the reception, restaurant and shop of before 1993, where the central building of today stands. Drawn after a postcard and the park map.

Visdiefje.why: The two bungalows of the old park that still stand, numbers 44 (the Visdiefje) and 5 on the old park map, both of type A4: drawn as the red bungalow in every era.

C1.why: Every camping pitch has the tent of C2 on it.

C3.why: Every camping pitch has the tent of C2 on it.

C4.why: Every camping pitch has the tent of C2 on it.

C5.why: Every camping pitch has the tent of C2 on it.

Trekker.why: Every camping pitch has the tent of C2 on it.

4MH.why: Mobile homes take the safari tent for now.

OTHER.why: Sheds and buildings without a type; drawn as a comfort bungalow on their own outline.

central_facilities.why: The central building is drawn as a number of wings, each a ReceptionWing.
